description: Migrate all GitHub Actions secrets to Bitwarden Secrets Manager using bitwarden/sm-action, keeping only BW_ACCESS_TOKEN in GitHub.

steps.task: Store all 7 secrets in Bitwarden Secrets Manager and record their UUIDs

sub_plan.description: Create each secret in Bitwarden SM and document the UUID mapping

steps.task: Create Bitwarden SM project for moafunk-radio (or reuse existing)

knowledge.notes: User must do this via Bitwarden web vault or bws CLI. Create a project to group all secrets.

steps.task: Create 7 secrets in Bitwarden SM: LIGHTSAIL_SSH_KEY, LIGHTSAIL_IP, LIGHTSAIL_HOST, GHCR_DEPLOY_TOKEN, GHCR_DEPLOY_USER, SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID, SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET — record each UUID

knowledge.notes: Each secret will get a UUID like 'be8e0ad8-d545-4f5b-bef2-...'. These UUIDs are needed in workflow files.

steps.task: Create a machine account (service account) in Bitwarden SM with read access to the project, generate an access token, and store it as BW_ACCESS_TOKEN in GitHub repo secrets

knowledge.notes: User already has BW_ACCESS_TOKEN stored in GitHub. Verify it is a valid machine account access token with read access to the project created in 1.1.

decisions: All 7 non-GITHUB_TOKEN secrets will be moved to Bitwarden SM. GITHUB_TOKEN is auto-provided by GitHub and does not need migration.

steps.task: Update backend.yml to retrieve secrets from Bitwarden SM instead of GitHub secrets

sub_plan.description: Add bitwarden/sm-action step to deploy job and replace secrets.* references

steps.task: Add bitwarden/sm-action step to the deploy job (before SSH setup) to retrieve LIGHTSAIL_SSH_KEY, LIGHTSAIL_IP, GHCR_DEPLOY_TOKEN, GHCR_DEPLOY_USER

knowledge.notes: Build job only uses secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN which doesn't need migration. Only the deploy job needs the Bitwarden step. Pattern: uses bitwarden/sm-action@v2 with access_token and secrets mapping UUIDs to env var names.

steps.task: Replace all secrets.LIGHTSAIL_* and secrets.GHCR_* references with step output references (steps.secrets.outputs.*) in the deploy job

knowledge.notes: bitwarden/sm-action outputs secrets as step outputs. Reference pattern: ${{ steps.<step-id>.outputs.<SECRET_NAME> }}

decisions: Build job is unchanged — it only uses GITHUB_TOKEN (auto-provided)
Only the deploy job needs Bitwarden integration (4 secrets: LIGHTSAIL_SSH_KEY, LIGHTSAIL_IP, GHCR_DEPLOY_TOKEN, GHCR_DEPLOY_USER)

steps.task: Update backup.yml to retrieve secrets from Bitwarden SM instead of GitHub secrets

knowledge.notes: Needs 2 secrets: LIGHTSAIL_HOST, LIGHTSAIL_SSH_KEY. Add bitwarden/sm-action as first step in backup job. Replace env-level secrets.LIGHTSAIL_HOST and inline secrets.LIGHTSAIL_SSH_KEY with step outputs.

steps.task: Update frontend.yml to retrieve SoundCloud secrets from Bitwarden SM

knowledge.notes: Needs 2 secrets: SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID, SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET. Add bitwarden/sm-action step in build job before the SoundCloud script step.

steps.task: Update generate-re-listen.yml to retrieve SoundCloud secrets from Bitwarden SM

knowledge.notes: Needs same 2 secrets as frontend.yml: SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID, SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET. Pattern identical to step 4.

steps.task: Test the migration by running each workflow and verifying secrets are correctly retrieved
Trigger generate-re-listen.yml via workflow_dispatch and verify SoundCloud secrets work
Trigger backend.yml deploy via workflow_dispatch and verify Lightsail/GHCR secrets work
Trigger backup.yml via workflow_dispatch and verify Lightsail secrets work
Remove old secrets from GitHub repository settings (keep only BW_ACCESS_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN)

decisions: Only delete GitHub secrets after all workflows are verified working with Bitwarden SM
knowledge.notes: Remove: LIGHTSAIL_SSH_KEY, LIGHTSAIL_IP, LIGHTSAIL_HOST, GHCR_DEPLOY_TOKEN, GHCR_DEPLOY_USER, SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID, SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET

steps.task: Update SHARED_KNOWLEDGE.md and README.md to document the Bitwarden SM integration and new secrets management approach

knowledge.notes: Document: which secrets are in Bitwarden SM, how to add new secrets, the BW_ACCESS_TOKEN requirement, and the bitwarden/sm-action pattern used in workflows.
